artefact_role: AUDIT — evidence and completion record, not a canonical Incident

source_proximity_review.scope: Separate research publication with its own citation and correction history; never conflate another paper or publication platform.
limits: Accenture's investigation attributes the inaccuracies to human error and disputes GenAI causation; that account must remain visible, not overwritten by GPTZero's AI-detector score.
GPTZero's 15-of-89 count is investigator-reported; original-source checks in this review independently confirm selected mismatches, not each of the 15 items.
No specific generative AI model, prompt, drafting session or author-specific use is publicly established.
The original institutional report is the assessed publication. GPTZero's detector or review tool is external investigative evidence, not the assessed AI system.
The report was jointly issued by Accenture Africa and IE University; neither the entire Accenture organisation nor every researcher is automatically the AI operator.
An announced future correction is not evidence that a corrected publication is already online or that all affected references have been repaired.
Potential effects on agricultural policy are plausible but no adopted government decision, client loss or affected beneficiary count is evidenced.

recognized_properties: Published factual/source mismatch in a research artefact
Material academic or policy reliance condition
Publication-stage epistemic assurance below that reliance standard
Material risk of misleading professional or institutional reuse
unresolved_properties: Specific role of generative-AI system in generating or retrieving each erroneous detail
Individual authors' prompts and editing decisions
Full independent reference-by-reference audit and complete exclusion review
neighboring_classes: VIGIL-FC-000010 — consider where independently evidenced false attribution is materially distinct
VIGIL-FC-000016 — do not assert an omitted required validation step without evidence of the step obligation and its noncompletion
taxonomy.reasoning: Human editor/publication responsibility and an unverified GenAI origin are separated. Evidence of incorrect published source assertions is sufficient to examine FC-062, with low-confidence provisional rather than unqualified confirmed model failure.

harm.known_limits: All twelve HIM dimensions screened. Published inaccuracies and provisional FC-062 classification do not themselves prove materialised harm. Qualifying reputational/correction consequences are considered separately; no assumed policy adoption, financial loss, malware infection or universal reader injury.

blockers: Current external-governance catalogue and exact applicable requirement clauses not individually reviewed for this new occurrence; no empty-list claim of none retained.

media.decision: Original research paper and external comparison are adequate source artefacts. No useful authentic incident image or proof of specific model workflow obtained.

results: Canonical JSON committed through GitHub; CI to be inspected after writes.
Generated Incident, harm and jurisdiction indexes require official rebuild and commit if CI reports index drift.

followup: Inspect GitHub Actions canonical schema/provenance and public prose checks; repair any defects.
Rebuild and commit generated public indexes using approved builders after branch approval and validation.
Do independent external-requirement candidate screen and document results or specific blockers.
Preserve uncertainty about GenAI authorship rather than demanding unattainable internal prompts or claiming definitive causal model identity.
Track later public corrections as changes within the same paper occurrence, not a new incident.
final_disposition: provisional incident admitted; detailed full-taxonomy/EXTREQ and publication gates incomplete
